description: This file defines a TypeScript module providing an in-memory stub implementation of a client interface for notes API operations, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of notes. Currently returns an empty array as a placeholder.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new note with provided partial data, assigning default values if necessary, and returns the created note.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing note identified by 'id' with provided partial data, returning the updated note.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a note identified by 'id' and returns an object containing the deleted note's id.
